Priya Nair: Morning — quick async update for the docs sprint. Sharing short notes: what I finished, current blockers, and what I'm tackling today.

Jordan Lee: Done — reviewed python SDK quickstart PR (link: <https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/789>). Left inline comments on auth flow. Blocker: CI wheels failing on macOS runner, can't reproduce locally yet.

Chris Park: Done — fixed some JS quickstart typos and updated the curl examples. Blocker: sample-app container crashes on startup with OOM on small test instance. Today I'll try a slimmer base image and re-run.

Priya Nair: Done — migrated quickstarts to new CLI flags. Snippet:
```
redwoodctl quickstart create --template=python --timeout=30s
```
Blocker: unsure about the default timeout value for tutorials — @Jordan any preference? Today: finish publishing updated docs and ping QA for smoke tests.

Jordan Lee: Prefer 30s as default for hosted quickstarts, but it should be configurable via env/flag. Also I'll dig into the mac wheel CI failure this afternoon.

Marta Ruiz: Did — refreshed screenshots and rewrote the 'getting started' intro for clarity. Blocker: README still shows SAMPLE_TOKEN in a way that might confuse readers; do we add an explicit note to use REDWOOD_API_KEY env var instead? Today I'll open a small PR to clarify.

docs-bot: CI report — build 482: tests passed; packaging/macos-wheels: failed on arm64 (see logs).

Chris Park: noted — opened issue #592 for sample-app OOM and a PR for the slim image. Will post test results when done.

Priya Nair: :thumbsup: I'll follow up on the timeout config and merge the CLI change after Jordan confirms. I'll be available in #devex this afternoon for any quick pair debugging.

Jordan Lee: If anyone hits the mac wheel issue, ping me and I can spin a reproducible runner. Good work all.
